martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · SINGLE-LEG STUDY
martialSupplement.home: Connect entry to one controlled finish. 3 slow repetitions/side without driving into the dummy.
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: One question: where do posture or connection change? Pause and inspect.
martialSupplement.text: 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
